note: Hand layer: rock slabs (berghällar) cut out of the course meshes into their own objects, outlines traced off the 2025 ortho (EPSG:3006). Each becomes Spline_<name>_Rock_-_Mesh.

ops.name: hall_h11_north
ops.note: North slab on the knoll east of hole 11's green: the rock seen in the ortho (about 5 x 9 m) grown 1.5 m all round (Marcus, 2026-10-08: the traced size read too small).

ops.name: hall_h11_south
ops.note: South slab, the ortho's rock (about 6 x 10 m) grown 1.5 m, kept 0.8 m off the north slab; its west edge is the steep lip (40-55 degrees in the lidar).
